title: Borland's congressional testimony on the Langley triangle

tellings.quote: During the summer of 2012, my team was on standby for weather and I returned to my barracks on base and at approximately 0130, I saw an approximately 100 ft equilateral triangle take off from near the NASA hanger on the base

plain: Dylan Borland, a former serviceman, read out to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, the testimony he says he gave to Congress in 2025. In it he says that in the summer of 2012, while his team was on standby for weather, he went back to his barracks at Langley, a military base in Virginia, and at about 1:30 in the morning saw a triangle about 100 feet on each side lift off from near the NASA hangar there. If true, it would mean a large unknown craft was flying from inside a US base.
